privacy_policy_page.title: Privacy policy
privacy_policy_page.intro: Welcome to NTHUMods. To help you use this website's services and information with confidence, this policy explains how we protect your privacy. Please read it carefully.

sections.title: 1. Scope of the privacy policy
items: This policy explains how the website handles personal identification data collected when you use its services.
This policy does not apply to linked websites outside this website or to people who are not entrusted with or involved in managing this website.

sections.title: 2. Collection and use of data
paragraphs: To provide the best interactive services, we may ask you for relevant personal data. The scope is as follows:
items: When you use interactive features such as service mailboxes or surveys, the website keeps the name, email address, contact information, and usage time you provide.

During general browsing, the server automatically records your IP address, usage time, browser, browsing activity, and click data as references for improving the website. These records are for internal use and are never published externally.
To provide accurate services, we statistically analyze survey content. We may publish the resulting statistics or explanations when necessary, but they will not identify specific people.

After login, the server does not store your password or session. Your password is saved on your device for authentication; unless otherwise stated, the website does not store other personal data without your consent.
Unless you consent or the law provides otherwise, the website does not disclose personal data to third parties or use it for purposes outside the reason it was collected.

sections.title: 3. Protection of data
items: The website host uses firewalls, antivirus systems, and other security measures to protect the website and your personal data. Strict safeguards are used, and only authorized personnel may access your data.
When business needs require us to entrust a related organization with a service, we require it to keep information confidential and use necessary procedures to verify compliance.

sections.title: 4. External links
paragraphs: This website links to other websites. The privacy policy of this website does not apply to those linked websites, so please refer to their own policies.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
paragraphs: To provide the best service, this website places and accesses cookies on your computer. If you do not want to accept cookies, set your browser's privacy level to high; some website features may then stop working properly.

sections.title: 6. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This privacy policy may be revised as needed. Revised terms will be published on the website.

privacy_policy_page.closing: This article is translated from the Chinese version. If there is any discrepancy, please refer to the Chinese version.

next_steps_page.title: Termination of NTHUMods proxy login for the CCXP system
next_steps_page.intro: The NTHUMods team is grateful for your support. To avoid concerns under personal data protection law, we will end the proxy login service for the NTHU CCXP system on May 3, 2025. Features that require a CCXP login will be suspended; features that do not require a login will continue to work.

sections.title: What happened
paragraphs: We received guidance from NTHU that the proxy login service may raise concerns under personal data protection law. Although no data breach has occurred, the team decided to end the service. NTHUMods is considered an external third-party platform, so our servers cannot use a user's account and password to log in to the university system on their behalf.

sections.title: What we are doing
paragraphs: NTHU does not currently provide a public API for third-party platforms to retrieve this data. We will continue discussing alternatives with the university and hope to provide a convenient service that remains compliant with the law.

sections.title: Looking ahead
paragraphs: We remain committed to making campus information easy to access through a clear, intuitive interface. We will continue following that principle and improving NTHUMods for students.

closing: Thank you for supporting and caring for NTHUMods. We look forward to growing with you.
If you would like to join us, contact the team through Instagram (@nthumods) or email (nthumods@gmail.com).

account.title: How we use your account information
account.intro: When you use NTHUMods proxy login, we need your student ID and password for initial verification. The process is:
steps: Send a request to the university login page to obtain a CAPTCHA image.
Use OCR technology to solve the CAPTCHA.
Submit your student ID, password, and CAPTCHA solution.
Verify the login and obtain a session token.
account.emphasis: Your information is stored only on your device. We do not store account data.

protection.title: How we protect your information
protection.intro: We take these basic steps to protect your information:
items: Your information is stored only on your device; sensitive information is not stored on our servers.
Passwords stored on your device are encrypted with AES-256-CBC.
protection.flow: graph TD; A[User enters password] -->|Encryption| B[Encrypted password]; B --> C[Stored on user device]; C -->|Decryption when needed| D[Use password to log in];
protection.reference: For more detail about encryption, see the authentication page.

process.title: Basic proxy login process
process.intro: Here is a simplified view of the proxy login process:

design_system.title: NTHUMods design language
design_system.description: Answer campus questions quickly, clearly, and reliably.

philosophy.title: The campus, answered
philosophy.intro: NTHUMods is the tool a student opens while walking across campus, with one thumb and a few seconds to find what comes next. Courses, grades, venues, food, and maps are the same act: less ceremony, faster answers.

answer_first.title: Answer first
answer_first.description: Show students what they came for; page furniture gets one line.

say_once.title: Say it once
say_once.description: State each fact once. Repetition only adds noise.

one_cloth.title: One cloth
one_cloth.description: Every page is made from the same shared parts; new shapes enter the system first.

purple.title: Purple is a verb
purple.description: Purple means you are here or can act; every other color carries data meaning.

quiet_craft.title: Quiet craft
quiet_craft.description: Personality lives in words and brief feedback, not in decorative chrome.

composition.title: Composition rules
composition.description: Every page answers one question first, then uses the shared shell, header, sections, and states to arrange the answer.
composition.content_description: Prose and side pages use max-w-3xl.
composition.app_description: Lists, forms, grids, and detail pages use max-w-6xl.
composition.full_description: Viewport-owned tools such as timetable, map, and chat have no maximum width.
composition.header_description: Use text-xl font-semibold for the title, right-align actions, and truncate the text-sm description on the next line.
composition.spacing_card: Card padding: 16; dense rows use px-3 py-2.
composition.type_display: Side-page display: text-4xl font-bold, once only.
composition.type_numbers: Numbers, times, course codes, credits: tabular-nums font-medium.
composition.empty_title: An empty state states the fact and offers a next step; never leave a lone gray sentence.
composition.empty_description: Use EmptyState: icon, title, one-line description, and at most one action.
composition.loading_title: A loading state preserves the answer's shape.
composition.loading_description: Use PageSkeleton for the header and rows; do not use a bare spinner or loading text.

primitives.title: Primitive examples
primitives.description: These components are the shared page skeleton. Each example below is a real composable primitive.
primitives.empty_title: There is no data here yet
primitives.empty_description: When data arrives, it will appear in this quiet space.
primitives.section_description: Section title, description, and content keep the same rhythm.
primitives.section_content: This is the card variant: no shadow, just one clear surface.
primitives.skeleton_description: The shape of the header and rows arrives before the content.

tokens.title: Tokens that actually exist
